t: What Livestock Welfare Database Is All About
title: What Livestock Welfare Database Is All About
description: Livestock welfare is measured, not assumed: the Five Freedoms (hunger, discomfort, pain, normal behavior, fear) frame it; lameness scores, body condition, and cortisol quantify it. Temple Grandin's handling designs (curved chutes, no electric prods) cut stress measurably. Better welfare usually means better production — stressed animals don't gain, milk, or lay well. This database is the complete welfare indicator: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
